node.title: Re^3: File::Find - Traverse the first level directories from starting point - How?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Why not? [doc://opendir] and [doc://readdir] are perfectly acceptable tools, the caveats that people commonly forget are to correctly remove the . and .. directories and prepend the directory name to the returned values. Both can be solved easily with [mod://File::Spec]. Personally I'd use [mod://Path::Class], but TIMTOWTDI:

use File::Spec::Functions qw/no_upwards catdir/; opendir my $dh, $dirname or die "$dirname: $!"; my @dirs = grep {-d} map {catdir $dirname, $_} sort +no_upwards readdir $dh; closedir $dh;
